newsitem.title: USA: Accent Color sinks after launch delayed.
newsitem.headline: Accent Color sinks after launch delayed.

text.p: Accent Color Sciences Inc's share price fell about 20 percent in early trading Monday following news late Friday that Xerox Corp would delay the launch of an Accent product.
Accent makes high-speed color printing systems.
Its shares were off nearly 20 percent in early trading, down 2-1/8 to 10.
The company went public in December at $9 a share in an initial public offering lead-managed by Cowen & Co.
Cowen said today it had initiated coverage of the stock with a strong buy rating.

Accent's "Truecolor" system is designed to upgrade black-and-white printers, allowing them to print color enhancements to regular black-and-white documents at high speeds, using Spectra Inc ink jet printheads.
Accent, according to a November prospectus, has an exclusive right through 2002 to supply products to certain printers from certain original equipment manufacturers.
At September 30, 1996, Accent had contracts "with only two customers, Xerox and International Business Machines Corp, and was negotiating a contract with Oc," the prospectus said.
Executives at Accent were not available for comment.
